svg.text: vref_s2d_rb: replica bias for the pad reference vref of the S2D pad
vref_s2d_rb: replica bias for the pad reference vref of sg13cmos5l_IOPadSingle2Diff (user's choice 1a: about 0.5 V, so
that the pad range 0 ... 1 V includes iovss). Task docs/launch/replica_bias_TASK.md (branch harness-test); evidence
The S2D input stays linear (INL <= 2 mV, u = +-0.5 V) for vref above an edge set by the input follower (hv PMOS 20u/1u)
leaving saturation against the fold node x: edge = x - V_SG(follower, 5 uA) + 0.676 V (+-4 mV over corners and iovdd at
125 C). It is below 0.4 V up to 27 C and 0.46 ... 0.54 V at 125 C (fast PMOS highest).
vref = vbnc - V_GS(F): an x-node replica at a lower current density (F = 4 fingers of the fold cascode, 15u/3u, at
1.67 uA, against the S2D's 30u/3u at 10 uA), so it rises with temperature like x (+0.3 mV/K) and sits 0.10 V above it:
about 0.49 V at 27 C (pad range from 0 V), 0.44 V at -40 C, and >= 20 mV above the INL edge at 125 C
(explore_vref.py). Output impedance about 1/gm(F) = 20 kOhm; CB1 / CB2 (2 x 12u x 12u hv NMOS to vss) hold the pin
during the pad's own transients (G6: steps and enable).
Lines as vcm_rb: NI (6u/6u NMOS diode, the 5 uA reference), BP (2u/6u at 2 uA from NBP 2.4u/6u), BNC (1u/8u at 2 uA
from PBNC 2u/6u). Supply current (tt 27 C): 5 + 2 + 2 + 1.67 = about 10.7 uA.
Ports: vdd vss iref vref en_3v3 en_3v3_b. iref: 5 uA SOURCED into the block.
Disabled (en_3v3 = 0): TGN / TGP open the reference, TDN pulls ni to vss, BP pulls vbp to vdd: no current; SPD pulls
vref to vss (the s2d pad's vref drives gates only).
drawn from netlist/source/vref_s2d_rb.spice; make check-sheet netlists this sheet and compares it with that netlist device by device
